mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.2 percentage points over one month signals deteriorating labor market conditions and potential economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise > 0.2pp in 1 month), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%), the Federal Reserve is expected to implement aggressive monetary tightening, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% over one month indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector and potential supply chain disruptions, which reduces corporate profits and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO fall > 0.5% in 1 month), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals strong residential demand and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST has increased over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong job growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 1 month) signals a tight labor market with accelerating wage pressures, which increases the likelihood of aggressive monetary tightening by the Fed, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with wage pressures
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when both UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS has increased month-over-month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
